text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini boleh dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 April 2012.

Pindaan Jadual

2. (1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] dipinda dalam Jadual

dengan menggantikan butiran 17 dengan butiran berikut:

"17. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai

Timur‒Fasa 2 yang bermula dari kilometer 365.544 Persimpangan

Bertingkat Bukit Besi (di koordinat U -15392.721, T +33595.713

Grid Cassini Negeri Terengganu) dan berakhir di kilometer

424.793 (di koordinat U +34307.904, T +13156.195 Grid Cassini

Negeri Terengganu) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari Pejabat Pos

Besar Kuala Lumpur melalui Lebuh Raya Kuala Lumpur-Karak,

Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur – Fasa 1 dan Lebuh Raya Pantai

Timur – Fasa 2) termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Besi,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Ajil, Persimpangan Jalan Telemung,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Telemung dan jalan-jalan

sambungannya.".

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual:

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR‒FASA 2

Dibuat 30 April 2012

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/3/2; PN(PU2)460/LXVI]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Roads Transport Act

1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 April 2012.

Amendment of Schedule

2. (1) The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] is amended in

the Schedule by substituting item for item 17 the following item:

"17. That part of the road known as the East Coast

Expressway‒Phase 2 commencing from kilometre 365.544 at

Bukit Besi Interchange (at coordinates N -15392.721,

E +33595.713 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) and ending at

kilometre 424.793 (at coordinates N +34307.904, E +13156.195

of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) (both distances measured

from General Post Office Kuala Lumpur via Kuala Lumpur-Karak

Highway, East Coast Expressway–Phase I and East Coast

Expressway–Phase 2) including Bukit Besi Interchange, Ajil

Interchange, Telemung Road Junction, Telemung Interchange and

its link roads.".

(2) The road with the speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is

shown on the map in the Schedule:

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

MAP OF EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY–PHASE 2

Made 30 April 2012

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/3/2; PN(PU2)460/LXVI]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

Minister of Transport
